executive_summary: On July 29, 2026, OFAC added 18 new entities and vessels to the SDN list under the IRAN-EO13902 program, primarily targeting companies and vessels involved in Iranian sanctions evasion. The additions include entities based in China, Hong Kong, and the Marshall Islands. No entities were removed or updated. The designations highlight the ongoing efforts to disrupt Iranian sanctions evasion networks.

notable_entities.name: Qi Hang Ship Management Limited
notable_entities.significance: Key player in Iranian sanctions evasion, with multiple vessels and entities designated

notable_entities.name: Hormuzsafe Marine Services Authority
notable_entities.significance: Iranian entity involved in maritime services, potentially supporting sanctions evasion

risk_implications.description: The designations of multiple vessels and entities involved in Iranian sanctions evasion increase the risk of unwittingly engaging with sanctioned parties, potentially leading to significant fines and reputational damage
The addition of new entities to the SDN list may require financial institutions to update their sanctions screening processes to avoid potential compliance risks

program_highlights.note: The IRAN-EO13902 program saw a significant increase in designations, targeting entities and vessels involved in Iranian sanctions evasion

compliance_recommendations: Conduct thorough sanctions screening of all entities and vessels involved in maritime trade
Update sanctions lists and screening processes to reflect the new designations
Enhance due diligence on entities and vessels operating in high-risk regions
